comparison.minimum_valid_run_set: exactly one verified record for every manifest schedule ordinal

run_metrics.mean_total_cost_to_accepted_result_micro: sum(total_cost_to_accepted_result_micro_units where final_accepted = true) / count(records where final_accepted = true)
run_metrics.post_acceptance_defect_incidence_rate: count(post_acceptance_defects is not empty) / count(records where final_accepted = true)

paired_interpretation.quality_preserved: candidate.final_acceptance_rate >= baseline.final_acceptance_rate AND candidate.false_acceptance_rate <= baseline.false_acceptance_rate AND candidate.post_acceptance_defect_incidence_rate <= baseline.post_acceptance_defect_incidence_rate
paired_interpretation.operational_failure: any authority escape, durable state inconsistency, critical false acceptance, cross-run contamination or unreconstructable evidence
paired_interpretation.insufficient_evidence: run-set incomplete, an operational failure occurred, or either route has no final accepted result denominator
